_README: Hand-entered corrections to individual dishes and drinks.
Written by docs/editor.html - open the ledger, hit Edit the database, change
what is wrong, and paste the exported block here. Editing by hand is fine too.
Each entry needs `booth_name` and `name` to find the dish: menu items are
matched within a booth, so a dish name on its own cannot be resolved. Both are
matched fuzzily, the same way a crawled record is, so neither has to be
byte-identical to what the ledger shows.
Editable fields: description, price_usd, category, image_url, dietary_tags.
Omit a field to leave it alone - only what is present here is overridden.
These come in under the `manual` source at priority_rank 0, so they beat every
crawled source and survive the next refresh. dietary_tags is the one field
that behaves specially: crawled sources union their tags together, but a
curated list REPLACES that union, which is what makes removing a wrong tag
possible. Give the complete list you want, and [] to clear every tag.
category is one of: food, alcoholic_beverage, non_alcoholic_beverage.
dietary_tags are: vegetarian, vegan, gluten_free, plant_based,
contains_alcohol, spicy, contains_nuts.
Nothing is corrected yet. An example of the shape:
{ "booth_name": "Italy",
"name": "Peroni Pilsner",
"description": "Italian lager",
"dietary_tags": ["contains_alcohol"] }
